sources.title: Arvell Reese: I'm going to be used in a unique way, I'm a weapon
sources.description: The months leading into the draft feature countless mock drafts that set expectations about where players will wind up once the actual event gets underway, but every year provides reminders that the real thing takes twists few people see coming.
